'''2007 Texas State Championship Blake Huffman LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Blake Huffman]] at [[2007 Texas State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' NPE
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
